name: Slide Up Image Gallery
description: Full-height dark gallery of staggered image columns with hover parallax. Clicking an image slides the grid away and a full-screen version of the photo rises in, with a return button.
contents: Header with heading, subheading and side label
Row of image columns with varied heights, tag and title per image
Full-screen image view with a return button
behavior: Hover moves each title and image slightly toward the cursor, easing back on leave
Click slides all columns up with random timing, sweeps an overlay panel, then raises the full-screen image
Return button slides the full-screen view down and drops the columns back
editableByProps: Images, titles, tags and number of items
Header texts and return button label
Background, overlay and text colors as Tailwind classes

needsCodeEdit.where: The two blur-[140px] and blur-[120px] divs at the top of the root

fixed: Root is full width and one screen tall with hidden overflow
Column heights are set for the first four items only, later items use the default height
Uses Tailwind color classes for color props, not hex values
